note: The Graham County Parcels viewer (experience b55dd57f...) draws parcels from services.arcgis.com/rr5PkYU3R3HXxyDH Graham_County_Parcels_New, but that service is Graham County, Arizona (Safford, Pima, Thatcher layers); its Parcels layer returned 0 parcels near the Kansas sample point. No Kansas Graham County parcel REST service was found on ArcGIS Hub/Online, the county appraiser site (only a Parcel Search web app), KDOR/KGS services (tax units only), or the DASC hub. ORKA requires a request for county GIS parcel data; commercial sources (Dynamo Spatial, Acres, Regrid) are not public services; Regrid tile-only MapServer does not support queries; Integritygis Kansas services require a token.
